subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/Infra deep-dive and confirm attendees
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantaflow.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: propose ML/Infra deep-dive (60–90m)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can get the right folks aligned.

Recap (2 mins):
- Quantaflow is prioritizing low-latency model inference for batch scoring and interactive features.
- Key success criteria: 50ms p95 for short-context queries, predictable cost under reserved capacity, and auditability for ML outputs.
- You flagged SRE + security as must-attend, and wanted a runbook for failover behavior.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute ML/Infra deep-dive (technical demo + ops runbook + rollout constraints). Goals: validate latency profile on your sample workload, confirm owner responsibilities, and surface any compliance blockers.

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — Introductions & goals
2) 20m — Infra + deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC)
3) 25m — Live demo: sample workload, batching & KV cache behavior
4) 15m — SLAs, observability, cost controls (batching/quantization)
5) 10m — Open items / mutual action plan / next steps

Please confirm who from Quantaflow should join (I saw that Samir, + an SRE, + security were requested). Ben (cc) will own the demo and infra walkthrough.

Availability — a few options we can lock:
- Tue 2026-09-15 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wed 2026-09-16 16:00–17:30 PT (preferred for our infra leads)
- Thu 2026-09-17 09:00–11:00 PT

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a proposed agenda for your review. Also included a calendly poll if you want to pick an exact slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/ml-infra-deepdive-poll

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet) ; ml_infra_deepdive_agenda.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Thanks Grace — this looks great.

Quick notes:
- Please include our SRE lead (Aisha Rao <aisha@quantaflow.io>) and our security architect (I'll confirm name tomorrow).
- Of the slots you listed, Wed 9/16 16:00–17:30 PT works best for our team.
- We'd like to see a short pre-read (1 pager) that outlines what data we'll need to share and any network requirements for a VPC/on-prem test.

I'll confirm the security attendee first thing Monday. Can you tentatively pencil us in for 9/16 16:00 PT?

On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 15:03 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see proposed agenda + MAP attached)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantaflow.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rao <aisha@quantaflow.io>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose ML/Infra deep-dive (60–90m)

Thanks Samir — penciled in Wed 2026-09-16 16:00 PT. Ben and I will own the demo and runbook walk-through.

Pre-reads: I attached a short one-pager (network_and_data_prep.txt) in the body below with the items we'd need to validate prior to the session:
- 3 sample requests (JSON lines) + representative sequence lengths
- Typical concurrent QPS and peak windows
- Any IP allowlist requirements for a VPC test (CIDR ranges)
- Point-of-contact for data transfer (SCP/S3 endpoint)

Ben — can you add a 10–15 minute slot at the start for our infra checklist (kernel/quantization limits, CPU/GPU mix)? I want to make sure we capture SRE constraints early.

If you confirm your security attendee, we'll add them to the agenda under compliance blockers.

We'll send a calendar invite once you confirm security attendee name.

Best,
Grace

---
network_and_data_prep.txt (pre-read)
1) Minimal sample payloads (3 examples) + sample token counts
2) Peak concurrent QPS and acceptable p95 latency target
3) Preferred deployment (hosted/dedicated/VPC) and any inbound firewall rules
4) Artifact transfer method (S3 URI or staging bucket)
From: Samir Patel <samir@quantaflow.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rao <aisha@quantaflow.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose ML/Infra deep-dive (60–90m)

Grace / Ben — confirmed. Aisha (SRE) and I will be on the call; security architect will join as well (Anita Singh, cc'd on a separate thread with corporate security). Wed 9/16 16:00 PT works — please send the calendar invite.

A couple of asks prior to the meeting:
- Please surface any known limits for model quantization that materially change output quality (we want trade-offs up front).
- If you can include a short runbook template in the invite (incident triggers + rollback steps) that would be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Samir
Head of Product, Quantaflow
